Follows lean-workspace-template's prefilled-markdown convention (`503ef262`, `1c2e790d`): first line is the `@sepo-agent` dispatch, guidance lives in HTML comments, one editable body.

- Adds `add-paper.md` and `survey-topic.md` (both routed via `/implement`, each with a swap-to-`/answer` hint and a definition of done)
- Adds `config.yml` (blank issues enabled + docs contact link)
- Deletes the generic `bug_report.md`/`feature_request.md` inherited from Quartz (lean's issue #64 flagged those as inappropriate for template repos)
- Keeps `ask-sepo.md` / `install-sepo.md` unchanged
